firstPlayerRule: The rulebook doesn't name a first player. Play begins with one player placing a piece in the centre of the table, then the other player places one of their own pieces touching it edge to edge.
clarifications: After the first two pieces, players take turns to either place a new piece or move one of their pieces.
Each player must place their Queen Bee by their fourth turn at the latest.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English rules linked from the Gen42 Hive product page (https://www.gen42.com/product/hive/). SHA-256 acf2ad802be54c177273baeb7bec234654084c7e4afac7611b3b4ea6ef0f7f8c. The 12-page PDF is image-only, so all pages were rendered with PyMuPDF and read visually. Cover: copyright 2010 Gen42 Games, author John Yianni. Printed page 1 (PDF 2), Preparation: each player takes all 11 pieces of one colour. Printed page 2 (PDF 3): "Play begins with one player placing a piece" in the centre, then the next player joins one of theirs. No page names which player or colour starts. Identity matches BGG 2655. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The rulebook does not say which player or colour goes first; choose any player.
Tournament conventions for who starts are not part of this rulebook.
This 2010 rulebook covers the base 11-piece set; expansion pieces are not covered.
